findings.title: Exit code for recreate upgrade changed from 4 to 3
findings.body: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE moves from 4 to 3, and 4 is reused for FEATURE_DISABLED. Any script that already treats 4 as "recreate required" will now read a disabled feature as a recreate upgrade, or miss the recreate case. The old code 4 now means something different. The documentation describes the new codes, but the change is breaking and nothing calls it out as a breaking change. The `check` command is still preview, so this is only a moderate risk.

findings.title: Feature-disabled check lacks exit code test
findings.body: The disabled-feature path in `run()` exits with code 4 for both `metadata` and `check`. The new test `testFeatureNotEnabled` covers only `metadata` and only asserts the error text. It does not assert the exit code, and `check` without the feature has no test. A regression in the exit code would go unnoticed.
